fields.climate: dry desert; hot, humid along coast; hot, dry interior; strong southwest summer monsoon (May to September) in far south
fields.terrain: central desert plain, rugged mountains in north and south
fields.hazards: summer winds often raise large sandstorms and dust storms in interior; periodic droughts
fields.resources: petroleum, copper, asbestos, some marble, limestone, chromium, gypsum, natural gas
fields.farm: vegetables, dates, milk, tomatoes, sorghum, chillies/peppers, goat milk, cucumbers/gherkins, cantaloupes/melons, cabbages
fields.exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, natural gas, semi-finished iron, fertilizers
fields.industries: crude oil production and refining, natural and liquefied natural gas production; construction, cement, copper, steel, chemicals, optic fiber
fields.languages: Arabic (official), English, Baluchi, Swahili, Urdu, Indian dialects
fields.religions: Muslim 85.9%, Christian 6.4%, Hindu 5.7%, other and unaffiliated 2%
fields.legal: mixed system of Anglo-Saxon law and Islamic law
fields.military: 18-25 for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
